changes.comment: Support calling `update` from useReactive() while the render window is open — the "adjust derived state while rendering" shape. The write already applied; notification is now routed so that only the writer is told during the render phase (same fiber, so React's render-phase update: output discarded, component re-invoked at once, no intervening commit), while any component that has already committed is deferred out of the render phase and delivered in the commit phase before paint, with a microtask backstop for a render that never commits. Previously the latter produced React's "Cannot update a component while rendering a different component" and a separate scheduled pass. Such writes must converge, which ordinary derived writes do with no guard since setValueImpl bails on ControlContext.equals — under the default deepEquals that covers freshly-allocated object and array literals too. openRc is now maintained in production, not only under IS_DEV for the wrong-rc guard, and rendered() drops its own tracker from the deferred queue since it just read current values.
